item.text:
Continuation research was completed across all eight selected chapters. No scores were assigned.

New defensible additions:

- `2B`: Japan provided approximately $470 million in bilateral grants and $30 million in non-lethal defense assistance through NATO, and revised defense-transfer guidelines in March 2023. This establishes concrete implementation beyond diplomatic rhetoric, while retaining a caveat that downstream battlefield effects are unproven. [MOFA Diplomatic Bluebook](https://www.mofa.go.jp/policy/other/bluebook/2023/en_html/feature/f0202.html), [MOFA release](https://www.mofa.go.jp/press/release/press4e_003247.html)

- `5B`: IMF evidence confirms that recovery reflected domestic demand, reopening, supply-chain improvement, and policy support, while inflation was linked partly to yen depreciation and reopening effects. Japan’s household data provide contrary outcome evidence: purchasing power remained pressured during 2023. [IMF Article IV](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2023/03/30/pr23100-japan-imf-executive-board-concludes-2023-article-iv-consultation), [Statistics Bureau household survey](https://www.stat.go.jp/english/data/joukyou/2023ar/index.html)

- `6B`: OECD confirms that the Children and Families Agency began operating on 1 April 2023, but also indicates that major child-policy reforms were prospective and that demographic and distributional problems remained unresolved. [OECD Japan Survey](https://www.oecd.org/en/publications/oecd-economic-surveys-japan-2024_41e807f9-en/full-report/component-5.html)

- `7B`: AP confirms Kishida was not the principal target of the fundraising investigation, while his faction’s accounting issues still required correction. Kishida later appeared before the ethics committee and promised restrictions on fundraising parties. This strengthens the distinction between systemic/factional misconduct and personal enrichment. [AP overview](https://apnews.com/article/9a24f47e73552422a1a41a1f537e0760), [AP ethics hearing](https://apnews.com/article/70500c6c0088bbcc)

- `8B`: The combined IMF, OECD, and household evidence strengthens the conclusion that Kishida converted priorities into machinery, but that implementation and outcome evidence remained partial.

Chapter `1B` was searched further but did not yield a clean independent 2023 finding of measurable nuclear-risk reduction. The defensible shortfall remains: policy intent, diplomacy, and civil-nuclear monitoring are documented; demonstrated existential-risk effects are not.
